messages:
alex: Heads up — we got a spike of customer reports about 'extra' token usage when clients reconnect mid-stream. Sample logs attached.
maria: Repro steps?
alex: Client opens stream, server sends ~120 tokens, client disconnects then retries and gets another 80; console shows 200 tokens billed vs expected ~120.
samir: My hunch: routing changed during the retry so the resumed session hit a different model variant with slightly different prefix accounting. Could also be missing session affinity header.
alex: We saw the session id switch in traces: old router -> new router (fallback). No explicit session header in the client.
ops-telemetry: Can you paste the trace ids + rough logs? also we need a metric for "provisional_vs_confirmed_tokens" sampling.
alex: trace: 7a3f2cc4, logs:
```
[2026-03-22T14:12:03Z] session=7a3f2cc4 started route=eu-west-1:small-model
[2026-03-22T14:12:07Z] client disconnected
[2026-03-22T14:12:10Z] retry accepted route=eu-west-1:small-model-v2
[2026-03-22T14:12:19Z] billed provisional=200 confirmed=120
```
ops-telemetry: That confirms routing variant swap. We should capture router-assigned "route_variant" as part of the billing trace. Also recommend adding x-session-id in resume path.
samir: Agreed. Implementation ideas:
- add mandatory `x-session-id` header on stream open, propagate to router and ledger
- router should prefer affinity to previous route if session-id is present
- ledger should tag provisional entries with session-id and route_variant so we can later dedupe on confirm
rachel: UX ask: Console should show provisional vs confirmed token counts per session on the request waterfall (single line expand). Right now provisional is a global stream-level event and it's confusing for customers.
billing-bot: "Provisional charge created: order=prv_01, session=7a3f2cc4, tokens=200"
maria: A couple of edgecases:
- What if client never sends session-id? we already see some clients that don't. Default to server-generated id and return it in initial chunk.
- How to handle tool invocations triggered after reconnect? they can be double-invoked if dedupe not keyed properly.
alex: For tool invocation duplicates we need idempotency token on tool calls. Propose `x-tool-call-id` that clients or runtime can set; ledger dedupes provisional confirmations by (session-id, x-tool-call-id) pair.
samir: On rollout: implement session-id header + router affinity in canary (10% traffic) then enable ledger tagging and a reconnect-deduper job that scans recent provisional entries and collapses duplicates.
ops-telemetry: Metric plan:
- counter: stream_resume_without_affinity (tag route_variant)
- histogram: provisional_confirm_delay_seconds
- sampled log: stream_resume_fulltrace (1/1000)
Also emit an event when provisional tokens are reconciled -> send to billing stream for UI.
rachel: For console changes, let's add a small flag in the request inspector: "Show provisional tokens" with tooltip: "Provisional are estimated tokens before final confirmation; may be later adjusted." Default off for now, enable for canary orgs.
maria: Tests:
- e2e: open stream, make router reassign midstream, retry with/without session-id and check ledger provisional/confirmed
- unit: ledger dedupe by (session-id, tool-call-id)
alex: Any objections to that plan?
maria: none from me. I'll take the router + header change. samir you ok with ledger tagging work?
samir: Yup. I'll own the dedupe job and the billing tag schema change.
ops-telemetry: I'll add the metrics and sampling, will coordinate retention and dashboard panels.
rachel: I'll prototype UI with a collapsed row for provisional and confirmed tokens; will link to trace id.
alex: cool — let's sync tomorrow 10:00 to review PRs. cc @ops-telemetry @samir :thumbsup:
